_doc: iOS visual QA scenes (docs/design/ios-visual-testing.md). nativeOnly (default: name starts with native-) = no -wgLocalMode, no driver. steps (tab | click (optional: true taps it only if it shows within 3 s) | tag: give the first visible match a DOM id for a native tap | scroll: scroll that element's scroller to its end, until it is in the viewport | settingsPage | api: {path, method, body} through apiCall, the write stays for later scenes | takePending: take every pending dose (GET /api/doses?status=due,snoozed, then POST /api/doses/act), so the meds timeline shows TL3 · all done; the write stays, so it runs late | snoozePending: snooze the newest due dose for that many minutes, so Today's Next up shows it "Snoozed until HH:MM"; the write stays until a takePending | fill: set that input's value and fire input | aiReview: answer the describe parse with those items and Estimate (FC2) | scanStaple ({scanned, mine}): scan scanned.barcode with the food DB answering scanned and the FC1 offer answering mine | file: put a picked file, content text (default {}), on that <input type=file> | consent: open that TrialConsent sheet | firstrun: open the W1 first-run picker over the seeded vault, or W2 with "trial", or W1 with a placeholder shell base (the IM1 invite line) with "invite" | invite: open the F1 "Have an invite?" sheet | offer: InviteSheet.offer(that claim URL), the P3 route | reminderHint: open the take sheet the way a reminder tap does, with the RD3 lock-screen hint re-armed | staleReminder: "taken" takes the first due dose, "moved" points a minute off it; schedules a real local notification (body "QA stale reminder", 15 s out) with the app's reminder url for the native notification step, or, when no shell delivers it (Playwright's stub schedules 0), opens that url as Shell.openReminder does; toasts stay up | inviteRequest: open the W5 "Request an invite" sheet with a stub POST, "sent" also sends it, "w4" opens it the W4 way (IM2 · W4) | openAccount: answer a placeholder shell base and open the W5 "Open my account" page with a full address, "invalid" commits a partial one, pull: "busy" pulls to refresh over a stub Apple Health import that never ends, so the .wg-ptr pill stays busy, "done" shows the PR3 ok toast, kept up, "stub" only registers that stub import for a native pullDown) and ready (selectors that must be visible): the in-page driver (tests/visual/driver.js). native: XCUITest steps after #wg-qa-ready (ios/UITests): tap (DOM id or placeholder), type, clear, tapButton (label), waitFor (label or id), keyboard (wait for the software keyboard), edgeSwipe (the shell's left-edge pan, bd med-y7b4.4; closes: a DOM id or placeholder that must show before it and be gone after), pullDown (a real finger pull from the upper middle, bd med-y7b4.7; follow with waitFor on the pill text), allowNotifications (tap the system alert's Allow if it shows), notification (tap the banner with that body text, bd med-wi09.6). Page scenes (Settings) open from Today first: a page keeps its origin tab lit, and each load restores the previous scene's tab, so without it Settings would light whatever ran before (med-e6ql). The page clock reads today 23:00 local (driver.js pinClock), so time-dependent text is stable; clock (optional, "HH:MM") pins that time instead (Playwright passes it as &clock=, the shells do not, so such a scene is cloudOnly). mask (optional): [{x, y, w, h}] fractions of the image that tests/visual/compare.mjs blanks before diffing (regions that still change run to run). localOnly: the cloud pass skips it. cloudOnly: the local passes (Playwright local, the iOS Simulator) skip it. platform (optional, "ios" or "android"): only that shell runs it. args (optional, native scenes): extra launch arguments, a `-key` here replacing the base one (Dynamic Type; the Debug-only -wgQALock failed|cancelled, -wgQALoadError 503|404|local, -wgQAHoldMark, -wgQACapture <link>: the link fills the invite slot at launch, real clock; -wgQAEraseLocal YES: local.erase's wipe over the seeded store before the first page, so native-local-erased, after the seeded scenes, shows the empty-vault first run and the next scene seeds again). settings-erase-confirm, settings-replace-confirm and settings-delete-confirm only open their typed-confirm dialogs (they never type the word); journey turns gamification ON for the device, so it stays last. startHere ({drop: vault data sections, picked: W1 picks}) replaces the seeded vault with a partial copy and reloads, so today-start-here runs after every other scene. noPlan replaces it the same way with the seed minus every plan (WN6), so workout-next-card-no-plan runs last too (workouts-plans-none, PL5, reuses that store after it). twoPlans replaces it the same way with the seed plus a second active plan, the seeded one grown to seven days (PL4), so workouts-plans-two runs after every scene that reads the seeded plan. workouts-plan-day (PL2) reads that store's day 7 and workouts-plan-day-started starts it (Start this day), so both run right after it; workouts-plan-day-exercise, between them, opens its first exercise's history page from it. pausePlans turns Active off on every plan through the app's own update (PL5 paused: the empty state over the Paused list); the write stays, so workouts-plans-paused runs right before twoPlans replaces the store. dropScratchWorkouts deletes today's finished off-plan sessions (the weightCheck / exerciseIdentity logs). clockAdvance moves this load's pinned clock on by that many minutes (negative moves it back, the way a scene the shells run reaches an earlier hour: meds-timeline-focus-in-view reads 06:00). inView (optional): selectors whose first visible match must sit wholly inside the viewport, above a bottom tab bar, or the report fails inView (the meds focus card's Take / Skip, testscenarios meds-timeline-later-on-top).trial (a trial status) stubs what the AI-trial offer reads (in account mode it also sets the trial flag the visual cloud server, with no trial key, leaves out). noAIKey answers the integrations read with the OpenAI key blank (the seed has one, which hides the Settings offer). localFeedback (true) answers App Attest and base.post for the page and mounts the local Settings → Send feedback row, scrolled into view (med-ta2n.20). emptyOverview (true) answers the Vitals overview read with {}, so the summary shows four dashes and every card its empty state (med-0xad.5). kitNudge (a kit-nudge status) answers the Today kit card's status read with it, for the rest of the run. shellSignedIn (true, cloud pass) marks the page as the iOS app signed into an account, so Settings shows the slot-② "Use this iPhone without an account" row (med-y7b4.2); it lasts until the next scene's load. healthCopy (row | offer | running | paused | done | refused) mounts the Settings Health card over a stub Health store with writing on, in page-only storage, and reaches that Copy past entries state (kit HW7, HW6, HW8, HW8b, HW9, HW9b; med-8f4s.11); the vault is only read. flowOnly (true): a step of an iOS flow test (ios/UITests), never a visual shot: VisualQATests, the Playwright passes and Android's local-visual skip it. euRegister ("us" | "eu", bd med-3u28.4): fails unless Settings stored that register choice, then reports the EU register check in the report's euRegister ("eu": opens the editor and commits Candecor itself, times the first load to the chip, counts asset fetches, checks the cache entry, then the phases; driver.js euRegister). FlowQACoreLocalTests (bd med-sz4k.6.1) steps: call (an app function by its global name, with args), fillAll (values into every visible match, in order), remember ({remember, as}: that element's text into the report's flow.memo, once per load), waitText (until that element's text contains text), coreLocal ({meds: name → daily times}: driver.js coreLocalSetup), openMed (that medication's editor from Meds → Schedule), takeDose ({med, at}: a precondition, today's dose at that time taken through the API). flow (true): the report carries flow (driver.js flowState: Next up, Timeline, Food, BP and Weight rows as shown, and targets: the on-screen rect of each named element, for a native tap); re-published on every DOM change.
